name: Vera Refresh
visual: Female-read tall pear-shaped blob, modest lashes, tiny dusty-blue ribbon. Phone clutched to chest in one hand, other hand makes tiny pleading palm-up. Eyes hugely hopeful with red irises looking DOWN to phone, raised inner brows, CLOSED strained upturned smile with one worried corner. She waits for approval, not excited gamer.
personality: She would like to be liked without having to keep checking.
biography: Vera measures HyperNorm afternoons in the time between reactions to her latest post. The Men in Black value observable approval. A dissonant card arrived without a response button. She answered it by visiting the neighbour who sent it and found the silence less alarming in company.
note: FrizzleBob: Approval is expected shortly. She has refreshed the expectation.
calls: Did anyone see that I was here?

name: Ollie Outrage
visual: Male-read wide box-rounded splat, short rust collar. One hand thrusts phone a little away, other ink fist tight beside own chest. One huge eye and other narrowed, ridges unequal, OPEN sideways three-upper-tooth rant. Outrage at something trivial, not soldier with angryVgrin; no floating flames.
personality: He has found an outrage large enough to fill the interval before the next one.
biography: Ollie patrols the HyperNorm feed for unacceptable remarks and acceptable opportunities to object. Hunky and Dory keep the supply reliable. A contradictory card made him angry at something he had said himself. He has not advertised the discovery, but his next apology was addressed to a person.
note: FrizzleBob: The matter is urgent. Its contents may be replaced without notice.
calls: This cannot be allowed to go unmentioned.

name: Felix Filter
visual: Male-read lean high-curled ink blob. Holds one TINY handmirror and one tiny phone together low beside own body, face entirelyvisible. One half-lidded vain eye, other appraising squint, CLOSED sharply tilted self-satisfied smile. Ink hand pats own crest while mirror/phone held by opposite hand. No full glam outfit or cosmetics pile.
personality: He looks exactly like himself after several necessary improvements.
biography: Felix arranges his HyperNorm reflection before allowing a photograph to become evidence. The Men in Black appreciate a consistent face. An ambiguous card asked what the neighbour would recognise without the adjustments. He kept one unedited picture, mostly because the neighbour looked happy in it.
note: FrizzleBob: He is being entirely himself. Preparation took some time.
calls: That is nearly the natural version.

name: Mabel Mutual
visual: Female-read broad scalloped blob, modest lashes, short fadedgreen scarf. Phone held low in one hand, other hand cups own ear as though listening for the next event. Huge whiteeyes dart sideways opposite bodytilt, brows high with anxious eagerness, OPEN tiny crooked two-tooth gasp. Upright restless twist, no ears as humananatomy.
personality: She fears missing the occasion more than she enjoys attending it.
biography: Mabel follows every HyperNorm gathering while worrying about the one happening elsewhere. Hunky and Dory promise there is always another. A dissonant card asked where she actually wanted to be. She spent a quiet evening with one neighbour and did not send proof until the next morning.
note: FrizzleBob: She is somewhere. The difficulty is everywhere else.
calls: Is that where everybody is now?

name: Lenny Lurker
visual: Male-read short round low-crest blob, bare goo. Tiny phone held just below mouth by both hands, not obscuring eyes. Thick heavy unequal lids, white sclera visible, irises slide sharply sideways; CLOSED tiny compressed smirk, one brow raised. Whole posture tucked-in but upright/fullcellsize. No trenchcoat, sunglasses or hiding behind wall.
personality: He contributes nothing publicly and maintains a comprehensive private verdict.
biography: Lenny reads the HyperNorm discussion without leaving a trace except a growing certainty that others are foolish. The Men in Black approve his careful observation. A contradictory card contained a question he genuinely wanted answered. His first reply was brief and rather kinder than his rehearsals.
note: FrizzleBob: He has nothing to add. His opinion remains extensive.
calls: I have seen enough to say very little.

name: Barry Broadcast
props: one compact phone on very short hand grip
visual: Male-read broad triangular splat, three uneven short goo crests. One smallphone on VERYSHORThandgrip at flank angled back toward him, other hand grandly points toward own belly. Wide earnest whiteeyes, asymmetrical OPEN four-upper-tooth announcement mouth, brows raised in exhausting enthusiasm. No longselfiestick, big tripod, screenspeech or lettering.
personality: He mistakes being visible for having arrived.
biography: Barry broadcasts HyperNorm errands as though an audience were waiting at every corner. Hunky and Dory encourage regular updates. A dissonant card asked him to put the phone down while helping a neighbour. He did, and later found the story difficult to explain without making himself the point.
note: FrizzleBob: The moment has been shared. Presence is still being negotiated.
calls: You need to know what I am doing.
